author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೇಶ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ ಭಾಷೆ ಮಾನವನ ಮೊದಲಾಯ್ಕೆ
ಕೋಶಗಳ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಪುಷ್ಟಿ ನೀಡುವವು
ಈಶ ದೈವದ ವರವು ಸ್ಥಿರತೆ ಮೂಡಿಸಲಾಗೆ
ನಾಶವದೆ ವಿಸ್ಮೃತಿಯು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Country, culture, language: these are a person's first choices;
the study of the great treasuries of learning nourishes them;
the grace of the Lord and the gods brings steadiness;
forgetting them is ruin, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Our land, our culture and our language come first. Studying the treasuries of our learning strengthens them, and divine grace gives them stability. To forget them is to be lost.
